description: INDE (Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais) is a data repository run by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE), found in the Americas country search of 2026-09-30. All geospatial data produced by Brazilian government institutions in one place: a metadata catalogue, a map visualiser, a download area and a geoservices catalogue. Coverage: Brasil. The homepage answered on 2026-09-30; its title reads "Página Inicial - Portal INDE". Text above taken from the homepage (page summary); the data pages behind it were not opened. It is reached through the link recorded on this page. Access to the repository is free of charge and open; individual data sets may carry their own conditions. The licence is set per dataset in the repository (not stated on the homepage). Caveats: only the homepage was read, so the data sets behind it, their formats, their licences and their current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of Brasil.
